decision: Use browser persistence and retain server ownership of interviews
why: Personal daily use should recover after closing tabs without requiring a backend for algorithms

decision: Integrated workspace, profiles, wizard, editor and lightweight history
why: Users can resume tasks and reuse data without changing business ownership

decision: Preserve the version read by each page when first-created records arrive from another tab
why: Fresh review reproduced silent overwrite of first profile collections; added a failing regression before fixing it

decision: Use native tab buttons instead of div tabs for main routes
why: Browser trace showed disabled div tabs still received clicks during deletion; native disabled buttons express the pending state and wrap on phones

decision: Allow the full derived review title without dropping source text
why: A legal 120-character role plus 100-character competency exceeded the old display title bound; reproduced before widening the local schema

decision: Disable scroll anchoring for dynamically filtered Hot 100 content
why: Pointer events showed scrollY changing from 849 to 889 between down and up, so clicks missed the question; the same scenario then passed ten consecutive times

decision: Remove local reviews linked to deleted interviews
why: Copied answer evidence and original-QA links should follow interview deletion; independent job profiles stay intact

decision: Freeze the verified personal-practice feature set
why: The final build, isolated database suite, full Chrome flow and startup diagnostics passed after the observed regressions were fixed
result: 186 tests passed; Chrome 24 passed and 1 external-import scenario skipped; axe zero explicit violations
